First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual to moderate, mixed ability.
Check
Look at @beacon.bicycle.coalition the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Beacon Bicycle Coalition Monthly Group Ride group ride

A monthly town ride from Beacon's old dummy light. Some months it is an easy loop around town; others go farther, even across the river. All levels are welcome. The coalition works on bike culture and safer streets in Beacon and the Hudson Valley.
